steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In February 2026, Equity Mates reported prediction markets spooked investors, with Flutter down 43% year to date, and said Flutter planned to pursue prediction markets via FanDuel, underscoring both competitive threats and strategic responses.

episode.title: Prediction markets are coming for Sportsbet & Pimp My Portfolio with Owen Rask

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates highlighted Sportsbet’s dominant 48% online share in Australia and said Flutter made $2.5 billion AUD revenue and $750 million operating profit from Sportsbet in 2022, pointing to scale and attractive margins.
